notes.title: To all the players
notes.content:
Thank you for playing The World is Your Weapon.

Thanks to your support, we were able to evolve the game to version 3.00.

We have information to tell you.

The author Kagaya-san, is not only a game creator but also a student at a medical college.

And he's trying to take an exam to get a pharmacist license in 2020.
This is a very important period for him.

Because he is making a game by himself.
To concentrate on studying for the exam, he is currently suspending the updating of The World is Your Weapon.

And if he passes the test successfully, he will be able to resume his creative again after April 2020.

Please support Kagaya so he can resume his creative with a smile.

Reported bugs will be fixed at a later date.

Thank you.

notes.title: Score Attack Video Festival (Survival Island)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35234635/a3e9d9b12b7341f05184787578edcd082db2540f.png[/img]
Thank you everyone for enjoying our game.

We will hold a festival (Events) where everyone can enjoy unreasonable and fun contents [b] "Survival Island" [/b] added in Ver 1.02.

[b][h1] Score Attack Video Festival (Survival Island)[/h1][/b]
The process is very simple.
Please share the play video challenging score attack in "Survival Island".

There is a section for each posting method.[olist]
[*] Youtube
https://www.youtube.com
Post a play video challenging "Survival Island" on Youtube and post a video URL on this thread.
The player with the highest score wins. Cheet is prohibited.
[*] bilibili
https://www.bilibili.com/
Post a play video challenging "Survival Island" on bibili and post a video URL on this thread.
The player with the highest score wins. Cheet is prohibited.
[*] For Players who enjoys cheats
Youtube and bibili are not specified.
In this game, even a kitten can cheat easily. We removed the debug mode, so it takes some effort.
Please post an interesting cheat screen as a video. The most interesting video is the winner.
Of course cheat is OK.
[/olist]
[b]In each section, the TOP player's name appears in the game.[/b]
[b]The deadline for posting videos is PDT 2019/07/19 07: 59. [/b] We can accept a delay of about 10 minutes.

[b][h1]What is Survival Island?[/h1][/b]
"Survival Island" is the score attack mode added in Ver1.02.Level 1 characters can also be challenged.

In order to challenge "Survival Island", you need to start the game and move to the Peaceville.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35234635/429d2eab0b9584e7ca84d3554b4f7308f5125d89.png[/img]
You can play the contents of "Survival Island" by examining a glowing well in Peaceville.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35234635/d65b62be7d7f0a7623f529162bab08ee19985c0d.png[/img]
Detailed explanations are also announced in the game. Please read carefully.

notes.title: Slap a goblin with another goblin in The World Is Your Weapon
notes.content:
Back in the early days of Dwarf Fortress, one of my favourite parts of the game was the ability to use anything as a weapon, from cups to dead lions. The World Is Your Weapon looks like a whole RPG built around this gleefully daft concept, and it’s out today. Developed by Kagaya, it’s a turn-based dungeon crawl (but not a roguelike) where weapons merchant Weaco can pick up and use almost anything in the world to batter her enemies or sell. Rocks, trees, entire bodies of water (somehow) and even other monsters are up for grabs. Below, a potentially lethal trailer.
